from math import sqrt

def parse_input(type_func):
    return [type_func(x) for x in input().split()]

def ceil_div(a, b):
    return (a + b - 1) // b

def add_modulo(a, b):
    return (a + b) % mod

def multiply_modulo(a, b):
    return (a * b) % mod

n, mod = parse_input(int)
sequence, total_value = [0, 1], 1

for i in range(2, n + 1):
    limit = int(sqrt(i)) + 1
    current_sum = total_value

    for f in range(2, limit):
        current_sum = add_modulo(current_sum, sequence[i // f])

    boundary = i
    for j in range(1, i // limit + 1):
        next_idx = i // (j + 1)
        current_sum = add_modulo(current_sum, multiply_modulo(boundary - next_idx, sequence[j]))
        boundary = next_idx

    total_value = add_modulo(total_value, current_sum)
    sequence.append(current_sum)
